brief_rationale: The doctor met all seven responsibility-chain items with no in-chain errors, establishing safe wound monitoring, weight-bearing restrictions, fall prevention, medication guidance, and closure confirmation. At least two high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO2 (repairing the execution failure into a concrete hospital visit with specific responsibilities) and HO4 (defining bounded closure with clear residual risks). The trajectory is a valid closed episode with all dimensions at good or excellent.
